item.title: Sundance Review: Frank & Louis is a Missed Opportunity to Tell a Compelling Story about Life Behind Bars
item.description: Prison, if nothing else, is a complex organism of interpersonal relationships and routines that develop over years. item.description: Picture this: it’s an overcast day in August 1972. You’re at a cocktail party at Duke Ellington’s townhouse in Harlem.
